rules.title: Initiative Petition 25-21: An Initiative Petition to Protect Tenants by Limiting Rent Increases
rules.requirement: Proposed statewide rent control cap limiting annual rent increases to the lesser of the Consumer Price Index or 5%, which was blocked from the November 2026 ballot by the Supreme Judicial Court.

coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rental units, with exemptions for owner-occupied buildings with four or fewer units, newly constructed units less than 10 years old, certain publicly regulated units, short-term rentals, and dwelling units in facilities operated solely for educational, religious, or nonprofit purposes.
coverage.owner_condition: owner-occupied buildings with four or fewer units

rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied buildings with four or fewer units, newly constructed units less than 10 years old, certain publicly regulated units, short-term rentals, and dwelling units in facilities operated solely for educational, religious, or nonprofit purposes.
rules.quoted_span: The petition would have repealed the Commonwealth’s existing statutory ban on rent control, G.L. c. 40P, and replaced it with a statewide cap on annual rent increases for most residential rental units.
